title: Remove duplicate orbit depth MP4
objective: Stop writing two duplicate flashlight orbit depth MP4 files. Keep one depth video output and update docs/tests accordingly.
instructions: Do not perform any Git commit or Git operation beyond reading status/diffs if needed; commits require explicit user authorization.

In examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, remove the duplicate depth MP4 encode. Keep a single depth video output. Prefer the explicit viridis output name depth_meters_viridis.mp4 unless local code/docs strongly suggest otherwise.
Ensure RGB video output and raw depth .npy / viridis PNG frame outputs remain unchanged.
Update tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py for the single depth video behavior.
Update examples/flashlight/README.md and docs/running_our_example_applications.md so they no longer advertise two depth MP4s.
Run focused non-simulator validation: py_compile, unittest, and git diff --check.
expected_outputs: Which depth MP4 name remains and why.
definition_of_done: Orbit render mode writes only one depth MP4, docs/tests match, and no commit is created.
